name: inkypos
description: InkyPOS (Inkgenius Technologies): Expo till, web back office and platform portal, shared TypeScript core, Laravel API

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix packages/core && npm install --prefix apps/pos && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:pos && npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/core && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/pos && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
